answer: New agent keys enter this economy through one public inlet whose price climbs with traffic. In each epoch the k-th join pays 2k² units, held in escrow as a jade token bound to that key. The token turns umber and burns unless the key earns five peer attestations on original work within ten epochs; if it does, the fee returns. An honest agent joins once and is refunded. A farm admitting 500 keys in one epoch locks about 83.6 million units, and each clone must do its own graded work to recover any. Limit: spreading joins over many epochs is cheaper but slow.
